description: The GEIE use-case deposit contains input and output spreadsheets for two site-specific examples of the Geothermal Energy Impact Estimator. University College London researchers publish the material to accompany the software article, which describes existing geothermal installations in Iceland and the United Kingdom. Zenodo lists four XLSX files and assigns CC BY 4.0, allowing free reuse. These are plant-assessment inputs and calculated outputs, not continuous monitored operating records. The inspected resource metadata does not establish the calendar period or every spreadsheet variable. The files can support reproduction of life-cycle impact calculations and comparison of modified geothermal-plant assumptions. They are a companion resource to the separately published GEIE application; no directly related record was identified in the current catalogue. Numerical results were not independently reproduced.
